meta.title: Oats Pipeline
meta.name: oats
meta.lede: Western Canadian oats from CGC weekly data: producer deliveries, licensed milling, exports by port and direct from country elevators, terminal receipts and commercial stocks.
notes: Milling is oats processed at CGC-licensed process elevators (“Milled/Mfg Grain”), mostly oat mills.
Most oat exports are direct: CGC records them as shipped from country elevators straight to export destinations, not through a port terminal.
